draft:
**Design system:** Coastal minimalism. Palette: deep navy `#0B2530`, seafoam `#8ADBC5`, warm sand `#F7F2E9` backgrounds, coral `#FF6B57` reserved for CTAs. Type: Fraunces (warm serif) for headlines, Inter for body. Imagery: real UI screenshots plus hand-drawn ink wave motifs.

1. **Nav** — Sticky sand-colored bar; wordmark with wave-underlined "o" left, four links center, coral "Start free" pill right. Subtle shadow on scroll.

2. **Hero** — 60/40 split: left, headline "Skip the Monday meeting. Keep the plan." with subhead on async weekly planning; coral primary + ghost "Watch the 90-second demo" buttons. Right: slightly tilted screenshot of the shared week board with avatar chips. An animated tide line traces the fold.

3. **Proof strip** — One centered row of six grayscale team logos under the stat "4,200 small teams ship their week with Tidepool."

4. **Problem** — Narrow centered column: "Status meetings are where weeks go to die." Two short paragraphs naming the pain; a single ink illustration of a tangled calendar. No CTA — pure empathy beat.

5. **How it works** — Three equal cards on a pale navy band: 1 Connect your stack, 2 Propose the week, 3 Commit by Friday. Flat line icons, oversized seafoam numerals, one-sentence captions.

6. **Features** — Asymmetric bento grid: large tile demos the Week board; smaller tiles cover async check-ins, a capacity bar that flags overload, Slack/Linear sync. One benefit line each, no feature-list padding.

7. **Testimonial** — Full-bleed navy band, oversized seafoam quotation mark, Fraunces pull-quote from a six-person studio founder, avatar and name in small caps.

8. **Final CTA** — Centered: "Your best week starts with one shared plan," coral button, reassurance line "Free for teams up to 5. No card required."

9. **Footer** — Navy with wave SVG divider; four link columns, changelog link, and an easter egg: live tide time ("Next high tide: 3:42 PM").
final:
**What changed:** static hero screenshot → looping product demo; empathy-only problem section → side-by-side contrast; generic three cards → a Mon–Fri ritual timeline; added an objection strip before the CTA.

**Design system** — Palette holds (navy `#0B2530`, seafoam `#8ADBC5`, sand `#F7F2E9`, coral `#FF6B57` CTAs; Fraunces + Inter). New motion rule: everything moves like water — 300ms eases, nothing snaps.

1. **Nav** — Sticky sand bar, wave-underlined "o" wordmark, links (Product, Ritual, Pricing, Changelog), coral "Start free" pill. Shadow on scroll.

2. **Hero** — 60/40 split. Headline: "Plan the week in ten minutes, not a ten a.m. meeting." Coral CTA + ghost demo button, micro-proof beneath: "Free for teams of 5 · set up in 10 minutes." Right: a looping animation instead of a flat screenshot — avatars dropping check-ins onto the board, a cursor reacting, the capacity bar filling to 80%. Tide line traces the fold.

3. **Proof strip** — Six grayscale logos plus one hard stat: "Teams cut weekly meeting time 60% in their first month."

4. **The contrast** — Split panel: "Monday, 10 a.m." (tangled ink calendar, meeting-fatigue copy) vs. "Tidepool, anytime" (calm board, clean wave). Bridge line: "Same plan. Zero meeting."

5. **The ritual** — Horizontal Mon–Fri timeline replacing three cards: Monday, propose the week; Tue–Thu, adjust asynchronously; Friday, the week locks and a digest goes out. Seafoam day markers, one sentence each — this sells the product's rhythm, not its features.

6. **Features** — Bento: large Week board tile; Capacity bar ("See overload before Friday slips"); Friday digest; two-way Slack + Linear sync.

7. **Testimonial** — Full-bleed navy, oversized quote mark, Fraunces pull-quote from a six-person studio founder, plus a metric chip: "3 hrs/week back."

8. **Objection strip** — Three inline reassurances on sand: SOC 2 Type II · 10-minute setup · Free up to 5.

9. **Final CTA** — "Give Monday back to the work." Email field + coral button — lower friction than click-through alone.

10. **Footer** — Navy, wave divider, four link columns, changelog, live tide easter egg retained.
